title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: High-throughput synthesis plus machine learning can map a four-parameter space and switch between colossal La-Ni cages by tuning alkali and oxalate, thereby resizing the n × m × l inorganic framework.
explanation: Traditional trial-and-error is contrasted with phase diagrams for La74Ni104 and La84Ni132. Alkali, oxalate, and related parameters are identified as influential, and the n × m × l count is the structural handle for cage size.
scope: IDA/oxalate La-Ni cage clusters explored on an automated synthesis workstation.
conditions: Four-parameter synthetic space including alkali and oxalate; high-throughput experiments with machine-learning phase diagrams.
caveats: The review lists remaining limits: more efficient automation, algorithms for multidimensional data, and richer time-resolved datasets.
